proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived sharp contrast-only transported-effect bounds, endpoint witnesses, a support/face strict-gain criterion, and a conservative finite-sample outer adapter. D0.5 graded the delivered result incremental below the field floor; an exact-overlap inference theorem, quantitative sign-power result, and replayable implementation remain new work. The sole panel dependency finding was repaired in graph main 83c172d52568 after the halt and mechanically re-rendered, but D0.5 did not re-review that repair; soundness is not certified.
tldr: The lead target compares two observation experiments. A contrast-only paired release fixes the source and target joint modifier tables w,q and randomized row and column contrast moments R,C; its sharp transported-ATE interval is nested in the interval obtained after coarsening both tables to one-way margins. A finite support, target-face, and effect-face stratification gives an exact boundary-inclusive strict-gain criterion with finite alternating-cycle tests and rational Positivstellensatz no-gain certificates. An explicit 2 by 2 family has a strictly narrower paired interval on a relatively open neighborhood. The paired report also returns sharp flow bounds, rational certificates, finite binary endpoint laws, and a face-correct point-identification witness. An explicit Hoeffding-McCormick construction gives 1-alpha whole-set coverage, exact LP size and finite bit-complexity bounds, sharp worst-case width two, sign-risk control, and refinement to an overlap-relaxed product set. Exact overlap-respecting refinement, useful finite-sample power, production integration, and attainable paired-table applications remain open. Classical information monotonicity, transportation cycles, McCormick envelopes, and Positivstellensatz machinery are credited.
gap: Cross and Manski and Cho and Manski establish the aggregate-data lineage for the value of joint covariate information. Moon is the closest marginal-covariate sharp-bounds comparator, and Li, Litvin, and Manski are the closest one-variable-at-a-time trial-report comparator. None studies a contrast-only transport experiment with both source and target cross-tabs fixed, active bounded effect-table faces, certified endpoint worlds, and strict endpoint gain characterized by target-table cycles.
fill: The project proves a strict paired-table information-gain criterion and a robust witness regime, then implements the paired experiment as a sharp auditable flow report with endpoint laws and face-correct ambiguity certificates. It does not claim generic information nesting, cycle mathematics, point identification, or coverage transfer as independent novelties.
